Database Schema and MongoDB
MongoDB, a NoSQL document database, aligns perfectly with the unstructured nature
of chat logs and metadata. The system uses the asynchronous Motor driver. The primary
collections are:
• users: Stores authentication details and encrypted passwords.
• workspaces: Acts as the root container for isolation.
• documents: Stores metadata regarding parsed files (filename, upload date, status).
• chat_sessions: Stores historical conversational turns grouped by session.
